channel.description: Bi-weekly observability market updates and quarterly reports. Data-driven insights on platform engineering and SRE practices.

item.title: Agentic Ops, Government Push, Elastic's Counter-Move (June 23 - July 13, 2026)
item.description:
Strategic convergence: multiple vendors moved simultaneously to own agentic AI operations and regulated government markets.

Key stories: Datadog acquires Adaptive ML (RLOps, AI Research division). New Relic Autopilot autonomous SRE agent and Ground Truth API layer targeting GA late July. Dynatrace and New Relic both announce FedRAMP High commitments in the same week. Elastic cuts 7%, CPO exits, launches Prometheus migration tools targeting Datadog and Grafana customers. Bernstein downgrades Datadog to Market Perform. Dynatrace board refreshed under Starboard Value pressure.

item.title: Autonomous Ops Race, Splunk Crisis, AI Code Paradox (June 9-22, 2026)
item.description:
The first two weeks of June drew a sharp line between vendors building toward an autonomous, AI-native future and those scrambling to hold their ground.

Key stories: Datadog DASH 2026 with 100+ new capabilities repositioning Bits AI as a fully autonomous operations layer. New Relic SRE Agent and no-code Agentic Platform. Splunk CVE-2026-20253 (CVSS 9.8) actively exploited, CISA KEV listed. Dynatrace: AI workloads drove 93% increase in log volume, 45% of observability budgets consumed by log management (~$2.5M/year/enterprise).
